request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for web, browser extension, iOS, Android, and beta channels

Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano node operation, DBSync/indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, transaction submission endpoints, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, ecosystem project support, wiki maintenance, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and creating governance proposals directly in Eternl
Independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics in February 2027 and August 2027
Conversion of up to $420,000 worth of Ada to stablecoins in a public company wallet, with Ada above that returned to the treasury
Semiannual assessment and possible repayment or donation to the Cardano Treasury based on remaining treasury stablecoins and Pro plan income
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements while Eternl introduces paid Pro plans as a path to sustainability.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available on web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000, calculated at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual costs.
The funded team consists of 10 contributors representing 6.0 FTE at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
If roughly 5,500 users, or about 4.2% of the install base, buy a Pro plan, Pro income would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
The proposer will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, hold it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

Independent audits of treasury fund use will be performed by an unaffiliated party in February 2027 and August 2027, covering receipt, custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro-plan income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.
Eternl reports that 10-18% of Mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The main Eternl UI will not be open-source, though some Eternl libraries will be published through the npm registry.

If the proposal is not funded and paid licenses are insufficient beyond August, the proposer says it may let developers go, scale down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, remove the free option, and reduce features, support, and infrastructure resilience.

summary: The document asks for ₳2,350,000 for Tastenkunst GmbH/Eternl to fund 12 months of wallet operations from August 2026 through July 2027, with a stated annual cost of about $420,000, a planned Pro subscription path to sustainability, treasury-fund custody and repayment commitments, and proposed independent fund-use audits.
